title: orchestrator: raise review diff cap 64KB -> 256KB (tunable PLAY_MAX_DIFF)
body:
Big pushes were instant-aborting on the 64KB v0 review budget. Raise MAX_DIFF default to 256KB + make it a per-push knob `PLAY_MAX_DIFF=N git push`. Models handle the input; the real ceiling is the ~300s/agent budget so giant pushes can still time out (split those). test.sh 42/42.
